decisions.reason: After two years without visible market presence, this peripheral consumer product likely sits well below aspiration levels for a firm centered on industrial sustainability, so management would reallocate attention and resources to core ventures.

Although no longer prominently visible, these modular extensions fit the established engineering business and can be supported with shared capabilities, so organizational slack and strategic fit make retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.

Despite its strategic logic, prolonged low visibility and the firm's demonstrated willingness to cull even flagship concepts suggest results have fallen short of aspirations and resources are better shifted to stronger core or new development projects.
